newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy likely to recover in late 97/98-MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy likely to recover in late 97/98-MITI.

text.p: The Japanese economy is likely to recover towards the latter half of fiscal 1997/98, spearheaded by private-sector demand, Trade Minister Shinji Sato said on Friday.
Sato also said he wants to see early implementation of the supplementary budget in the next parliament session, which begins later this month, to help the economy recover.
The 1997/98 fiscal year starts in April.
